{{Top|leg}}
The '''Servo Seven''' was originally a group of seven [[Droid/Legends|droids]], who believed that [[Droid rights/Legends|droids' second-class status in galactic society was unfair]]. The droids seized a droid manufacturing plant and held it for two weeks, shutting down production to bring attention to their cause. The droids were captured and deactivated

The symbol of this cause was a stylized gear with the number 7 on it. This symbol was used by pro-droid groups, as well as [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid]] groups, who would use it to sign their violent acts in an attempt to discredit droid rights movements.
